testsuite.name: com.textpic.studio.ime.KeyboardViewTest

testcase.name: symbols page two is reached through the backslash key and returns
space and backspace reach the listener once per tap
a number field starts on the numpad
password fields get a plain keyboard and no personalisation
a taller preference makes the keyboard taller
shift turns the next letter into a capital
the question mark key opens the symbols page
tapping Send in the toolbar reaches the listener
the view is sized to the Gboard proportions
the numpad page is reached from the symbols page and returns to letters
